branch.question: Wikisource Strong's lists the letter מ as a form of the word for "what" (mah), so the card of the letter offers "what". The text writes mah as that one joined letter at 3 places (Mal 1:13, 1Ch 15:13, 2Ch 30:3) of the 5,930 where מ is a piece of a word; everywhere else the letter means "from". Should the readings of "what" stay on the letter?
